about: A level-cap step, in a wild battle: the Zephyr Badge: the cap is 19 (GetLevelCap). A level-13 Snorlax, one point short of its next level, leads against a forced wild Geodude and switches out for a level-19 Tauros at the cap, also one point short, which knocks the Geodude out with Guillotine (taught in the battle, its accuracy roll forced). Both took part: Snorlax, under the cap, gains and grows to 14 -- past the old cap; Tauros, at the cap, gains nothing and no line says it did. A level-18 Ditto holding an Exp. Share, one point short too, takes its share without taking part and grows to 19: with the Tauros's nothing at 19, the cap is 19 exactly, where the two alone showed only a range. The battle has to end (gDiagBattleState 15, EXIT). The field's RNG is pinned as in rolls_forced_high.json.
